definitions.gloss: fake crying; crocodile tears; pretending to cry
definitions.explanation: crying that is not genuine, used to manipulate or deceive others

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{嘘泣|うそな}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ。
examples.english: That child is good at fake crying.

examples.japanese: {嘘泣|うそな}き⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{甘|あま}えた→甘える：06624_amaeru⟧。
examples.english: I fake-cried to get attention from my parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{嘘泣|うそな}きだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見抜|みぬ}かれた→見抜く：06975_minuku⟧。
examples.english: They saw through my fake crying.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧ (lie) + {泣|な}き (crying)

USAGE:
Often associated with children trying to get their way, but can also refer to adults using tears manipulatively.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {嘘泣|うそな}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to fake cry
- {嘘泣|うそな}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見抜|みぬ}く→見抜く：06975_minuku⟧ - to see through fake crying
- {嘘泣|うそな}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧ - good at fake crying

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{作|つく}り{笑|わら}い→作り笑い：08473_tsukuriwarai⟧ - fake smile
- ⟦もらい{泣|な}き→もらい泣き：08464_morainaki⟧ - sympathetic crying (genuine)
- ⟦{号泣|ごうきゅう}→号泣：15038_goukyuu⟧ - wailing (genuine)
